frequency_volume_note.text: Weekly frequency is primarily a way to distribute useful work and practise a skill. If weekly volume is equated, frequency alone may have a smaller effect on hypertrophy than popular gym advice suggests; strength practice may benefit from more frequent exposure to the target lift. Newer meta-regression suggests volume has a positive but diminishing-return relationship with both hypertrophy and strength, while frequency appears more consistently related to strength than hypertrophy. [S11] [S03]
